title: Crediting of dividends.
bodyText: An insurer shall credit annually beginning not later than the fifth policy year, any dividend arising under a participating industrial life insurance contract.
bodyHtml: §431:10D-311  Crediting of dividends.  An insurer shall credit annually beginning not later than the fifth policy year, any dividend arising under a participating industrial life insurance contract. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
